test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sectors includes banking, communication and transport?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tertiary Sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **tertiary sector**, also known as the service sector, is one of the three main economic sectors of an economy, alongside the **primary** and **secondary sectors**.
 
• This sector focuses on providing **services** rather than goods, including activities such as **banking, communication, transportation, education, healthcare**, and other professional services.
 
• **Banking**, as a financial service, is an integral part of the tertiary sector, facilitating transactions, credit, and financial management for individuals and businesses.
 
• **Communication** services such as telecommunication, internet, and postal services also fall under the tertiary sector, as they enable the exchange of information and ideas.
 
• **Transport** services are a key component of the tertiary sector, including railways, airlines, shipping, and road transport, which facilitate the movement of goods and people.
 
• The tertiary sector plays a crucial role in the economic development of a country by providing employment opportunities and contributing to the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**.
 
• With the advancement of technology and globalization, the tertiary sector has experienced significant growth in recent decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Quaternary Sector**__

 __
 
• The **quaternary sector** is focused on knowledge-based industries, including **research, development, information technology, and education**.
 
• This sector is also referred to as the **knowledge economy**.
 
• Examples include software development, consulting, and scientific research.
 
 
 
• **Secondary Sector**__
 __
 
• The **secondary sector** involves the transformation of raw materials into finished goods through **manufacturing and industrial processes**.
 
• Examples include industries like **steel production, automobile manufacturing, and construction.**
 
 
 
• **Primary Sector**__
 
 
• The **primary sector** deals with the extraction and harvesting of natural resources, such as **agriculture, fishing, forestry, and mining**.
 
• This sector forms the base of the economy and supplies raw materials for the secondary sector.
